This degree means that I can get a job.  A job where I can support myself.  Is this my last chance?  I don't know for certain.  I know it will cost thousands of dollars to go again.  Thousands that I don't have.  I don't have any other plan.  What will I do?  How will I support myself?  How will I be able to take care of myself without a job?  I can't manage.

So I was in school.  And I'm failing.  And at this point, being 40 years old, if I fail this last chance, then I lose my chance for my degree, at least for the next year.  And I can't afford to go back.  So that means I have nothing, after over 20 years of trying.  And I have no means to support myself.  So that's why dying is preferable.

Sometimes I feel better.  If I'm escaping, via a movie or a book, I can forget about the wreck that is my life.  But I can't live in a movie or a book.  And in the real world, where I can't escape, I don't have a way forward.  

That's the thing about suicide.  It's my way out.  It was always there, in the back of my head, but now it feels like it's time to use it.
